purpose: Teach: 於け/探訪/無実/乞う/絶た/幾多/慶応/変調

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時下に於ける学術の状況を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you chose to write about academic life during wartime in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Steady eye contact. Slight nod with the question, inviting confirmation. Professional but genuinely interested in her work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、伝統工芸の里の探訪記事を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about visits to traditional craftspeople's villages for my paper.
lines.style: Clear and composed. Direct eye contact back. Respectful but not deferential. A student confident in her choice, speaking plainly to an adult who listens.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 冤罪、つまり無実の罪の事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also covered false accusations — wrongful convictions — in one of your papers, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the clarification. Gentle correction offered as support, not criticism. Watching for how she responds. Slower pace, letting the weight of the topic breathe.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、被害者ご家族が支援を乞う声明を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on statements where victims' families were asking for support.
lines.style: Steady voice, grounded. She meets the weight of the topic without flinching. Respectful of the subject matter. Speaking with quiet seriousness about something difficult.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下で連絡が絶たれた記録を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you wrote about records from wartime when communications were cut off?
lines.style: Same warm steadiness as before. Acknowledging the pattern of heavy subjects she's chosen. Not judgmental—curious and approving. Slight tilt of understanding.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、明治期の幾多の苦難の記録を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the many recorded hardships from the Meiji period.
lines.style: Consistent composure. She's settled into the rhythm of being asked about her work. Direct, unhurried. There's a quiet kind of strength in how plainly she answers.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 慶応年間の社会変動の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your final paper addressed social change during the Keio era, correct?
lines.style: Still warm, still present. A slight shifting in her posture—this is the last one. Giving it the same weight and respect as the others, not rushing toward closure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、患者の体調変調の医療記録を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined medical records of a patient's health conditions changing over time.
lines.style: Clear, final answer. She's completed the thought. No drop in confidence. Slight settling—not relief exactly, but the natural rest of someone finishing what they came to do.
